description: The pie chart shows the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages based on the number of utterances, and it contains six slices. The slices are labeled Neutral (a dark blue/purple segment, about 23.1%), Happiness (a light blue segment, about 8.1%), Excitement (a red segment, about 14.1%), Sadness (an orange segment, about 14.7%), Anger (a yellow segment, about 14.9%), and Frustration (a cyan/light teal segment, about 25.1%). Percentage values are printed inside the slices, there is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the categories are arranged around the circle without an explicit visual indication of ordering by size.
